New Zealand names T20 squad for India series, Santner to captain

New Zealand has announced a 16-member squad for a five-match T20 series against India. Mitchell Santner will captain the team. Adam Milne and Michael Bracewell have returned to the squad, while Rachin Ravindra is out due to a shoulder injury. The team includes seven fast bowlers. Finn Allen and Tim Seifert are expected to open the batting.
